Content from ScottFalco's now deleted alt, ScootFlippo (2018-2023,I think). Yup, Scott actually did porn, not just lewds.

These pics are semi-lost media: most sites (including this one) only seem to upload the SFW(ish) art from his main, or AI nude edits thereof. Only place that had them was rule34.xxx, I then followed their source links to Wayback Machine and found a couple more. There were 1 or 2 with no source, but I believe all of these are his.

Archive of ScootFlippo posts:
https://web.archive.org/web/*/twitter.com/scootflippo*

Proof that ScootFlippo is (or was) ScottFalco's alt:
https://x.com/ScottFalco/status/114220943435935744

It should also be on the Wayback Machine, in case it gets deleted (under twitter.com instead of x.com)

Another reason I'm posting this is as a signal boost: I know for a fact there are more images out there that I don't have. If anyone has them, can find them on WM, or encounter them in the wild, please share with the rest of us.
